subject: A Stan presentation at the Paris Machine Learning meetup ?

messages.author: c3d9699a8d619601
messages.subject: A Stan presentation at the Paris Machine Learning meetup ?
parts:
Hello,

I was wondering if somebody within the Stan community would be interested in doing a 15 minute presentation on Stan at one of our future meetups in Paris ( http://www.meetup.com/Paris-Machine-learning-applications-group/ ). A local presenter would be great but we have had some good experience with video streaming presentations (Google Hangout). Our future dates for Season 3 include the following:

9th March
13th April
11th May
8th June

The meetup start around 7:00PM Paris time which amounts to roughly lunch time for speakers in the US. We try to not limit the questions from the audience. If interested, please contact me: igorcarron at gmail.  

To get a feel of the type of presentations, we like technical talks but we are also ok with less technical discussions when the subject warrants it. All the presentations of the past 35 previous meetups are located here: http://nuit-blanche.blogspot.com/p/paris-based-meetups-on-machine-learning.html

Thank you for your attention and sorry for breaking the flow of technical discussions.

Cheers,

Igor.
